name: Patron's Whisper
text: You gain the ability to speak to your charge over great distances. You gain Message as an innate cantrip of your former patron's tradition. You can send a message to a creature regardless of range if they have ever been your charge. If you Lie as part of the message, the target receives a –2 circumstance penalty to their Perception DC and to Sense Motive checks to reveal the lie.
